selection: Only the prior manifest's exact64 paired_fit duplicate groups. Sort SHA256(selection_seed + pipe + group); first16 secondary_check, remaining48 fit. Prior paired_development_evaluation rows are never decoded. This is repartitioned previously consumed development, not fresh independent evaluation.
misaligned_control: Reuse the final local checkpoint and roll its8x8 weight maps by4 cells on both axes before interpolation. Same learned response bases; no extra fitting.
primary_metric: Native encoded-sRGB mean absolute error, averaged equally across the three styles within each secondary-check source, then equally across16 source groups. Strongest global comparator is the minimum aggregate error across pooled/full_global/shared_global; primary relative gain is1-local_mean/best_global_mean.
visual_rule: A numerical pass is insufficient. Fixed first4 secondary-check groups in frozen order x ALL3styles: inspect original,target,local and all global comparators plus misalignment control at native resolution. Also inspect ALL4 already-consumed challenge sources x3styles without paired targets. Retain only if local adaptation is visibly worthwhile and coherent, with no severe face/text/object visibility loss, false color contours or inconsistent local lighting. No passing-style rescue or user preference inference. Failure closes this exact pilot without tuning/restarting.
preprocessing: Reuse scripts.run_ai_paired_recipe_pilot.decode unchanged: pinned file hashes, embedded AdobeRGB/sRGB ICC via LittleCMS relative-colorimetric to sRGB8. Training uses the same192square interpolation for every arm; secondary-check and challenge outputs retain original native HxW. Encoder alone sees64square context. No output geometry resampling/warping.
learned_supervision: Existing paired FilmSet CaptureOne digital-recipe targets, not agent-authored teacher images, physical film, calibrated stock, grain or optics labels. Every coefficient and spatial mixture is learned jointly; no per-photo hand tuning or target access at inference.
claim_ceiling: Private development-only automatic source/style-conditioned FilmSet-look model, still LUT-based. Duplicate groups are proxies for capture lineage. No independent test, public release, calibrated stock, full-Fable or user photographic acceptance claim. Soft LUT folding regularization, convex gamut and fixed coordinates do not guarantee semantic preservation.
integration_decision: This directly tests a joint full-color photometry learner. A retained result permits a separately frozen own-photometry development integration; it does not borrow a previously successful renderer or promote expert recipes to film truth. Rejection means this model/supervision combination did not earn local adaptation under this budget, not a ban on supervised or spatial learning.
